author: Kairos I
title: Entropy v2.1 (auto): CI expansions to multiple weighted averages (v36–v42)
abstract: Auto-discovers v36–v42 specimens; computes weighted-average CIs (inv_var, B=1000, seed=42) for epersistence, ks beta, ks uniform, shannon, top1/top2, tail_ethic_q95.

original_submission.content:
import os, re, glob, shlex, subprocess

base = "storage/shared/entropy_collab"
pat  = os.path.join(base, "erudite_v*_specimen.json")

def ver_num(path):
    m = re.search(r"erudite_v(\d+)_specimen\.json$", path)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else -1

specs = [p for p in glob.glob(pat) if 36 <= ver_num(p) <= 42]
specs.sort(key=ver_num)
print("V21_AUTO_DISCOVER", specs)

if len(specs) < 2:
    print("V21_ABORT: need >=2 specimens; found:", len(specs))
else:
    cmd = "python storage/shared/entropy_collab/examples/run_multi_specimen_v2_1.py inv_var 1000 42 " + " ".join(specs)
    rc = subprocess.call(shlex.split(cmd))
    print("RUN_V21_AUTO_RC", rc)
